MetaCartel is a decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that operates as a venture collective. MetaCartel is governed collectively by its token holders. MetaCartel invests in early-stage decentralized finance projects.

Bitcoin Hivemind is a prediction-market-based governance and oracle proposal. Bitcoin Hivemind was proposed by Paul Sztorc. Bitcoin Hivemind aims to determine outcomes through the aggregated judgments of market participants.

SushiSwap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. SushiSwap was forked from Uniswap in 2020. SushiSwap is governed by holders of its SUSHI token. SushiSwap runs on the Ethereum blockchain.

Opyn is a decentralized options protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Opyn issues options as tokenized contracts called oTokens. Opyn operates non-custodially, so users keep control of their assets through smart contracts.

Numerai is a crowdsourced hedge fund that runs a data science tournament. Numerai uses the NMR token, an ERC-20 token on Ethereum, to stake and reward participants. Numerai provides encrypted data to participants for building machine learning models.
